THE PHYSICS

ε = −N dΦ / dt

The EMF is zero when the field reaches a peak, and greatest when the field changes fastest. The induced current opposes the change in magnetic flux through the coil.

TRY AN EXPERIMENT

Twice the turns

Record the peak EMF with 20 turns, then try 40. What changes if frequency is doubled instead?

Inside this model +

A stationary N-turn coil normal to a prescribed B(t) = B₀ cos(2πft). Constant total resistance; self-inductance and the coil’s feedback on the imposed field are neglected. Positive flux is out of the screen; positive EMF drives counterclockwise current. Display time is slowed.

Φ = AB per turn; ε = −NA dB/dt = 2πfNAB₀ sin(2πft); I = ε/R.
